summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Transportation to investigate pricing practices on private toll roads, referring instances of price gouging to the Attorney General and FTC, and to study the feasibility and implications of the federal government purchasing private toll roads and transferring them to states to potentially lower commuter costs.

scores.thoughts: The bill directs the Secretary of Transportation to conduct an investigation and a study, and to submit a report to Congress. These activities would require some level of government expenditure, but the bill does not authorize significant new spending programs or large-scale federal purchases. The spending is limited to the administrative costs of the investigation, study, and report.
